s: January 27, 2021 - (I want to buy…) Prices are usually well-marked and already include sales tax. If you have questions about the price of something, you can ask Hur mycket kostar det här? Items marked REA! or Extrapris! are on sale for a reduced price (sänkt pris). When it’s time to pay, you go to the cashier – kassan – to check out. Paying with cash (kontanter) is increasingly uncommon as Sweden aims to become a cash-free society.
